notes: Proved in Lean (Mathlib) for squarefree n >= 1: A228885_formula (Oudra: a(n) = (-1)^floor(n/2) prod_{d|n} phi(d)^phi(n/d)) and A228885_sign (Sun: (-1)^(n(n-1)/2) a(n) > 0), with the matrix indexed by 1..n as in the entry. Built here: det_hankel_zmod (det of v(x+y+2) over ZMod n = sign(x -> -x) times the DFT eigenvalues), eig_ram (eigenvalues are Ramanujan sums), ram_squarefree (von Sterneck for squarefree n), sign_neg_zmod and prod_mu_sign (fixed points 0 and n/2), prod_totient_gcd. The zero case for non-squarefree n is proved in the entry itself and not formalized here. Outside Lean: none.
